note: Approved local-display producer identities. The ECS api compares SHADOW_SYNC_CODE_SHA/SHADOW_SYNC_CONFIG_HASH with each bundle manifest; a mismatch is not shown as current data. Application releases are deliberately decoupled from the producer identity (a website-only release must keep an existing bundle readable), so advancing the producer is a separate, recorded act: publish from a clean worktree at this exact code_sha/config_hash, then update the ECS env in the same change window. Never copy a SHA from a bundle into the env without a fresh 34/34 qualified compute run.
